paths.name: Path of Confession
paths.description: A mastery path focused on toe-to-toe combat

ability.name: Seeker's Triumph
ability.description: Seeker's Blade will now ignore 50% of the target's armor, and its cooldown time is reduced by 5 seconds.

ability.name: Seal of Destruction
ability.description:
A holy relic created under the tutelage of Elven mages, the Seal allows your attacks to ignore 25% the victim's armor for the next 7 seconds and  increasing your run speed by 50% for 7 seconds. If you use any abilities, the movement speed increase will immediately end.
You may only use a single relic at a time.

ability.name: Sanctified Bullets
ability.description: Your Blessed Bullets will now heal you for 100% of the damage that they cause.

ability.name: Repel Blasphemy
ability.description: A melee attack that deals 389 damage.  Your chance to parry attacks is increased by 100% for the next 5 seconds.

ability.name: Blessed Blade
ability.description: Your Armor Penetration is increased by 25% for 3 seconds when you use an Execution.

ability.name: Dragon Gun
ability.note:
Execution - Requires Accusations
Requires Pistol
Costs 20% fewer action points per Accusation spent
ability.description:
A pistol shot that damages and knocks down your primary target for 3 seconds and deals damage to all other enemies near them, reducing their Morale by 125. Inspired, your group gains 125 Morale.
   1 Accusation:  204 damage, 25 feet radius.
   2 Accusations:  265 damage, 30 feet radius.
   3 Accusations:  329 damage, 35 feet radius.
   4 Accusations:  391 damage, 40 feet radius.
   5 Accusations:  452 damage, 45 feet radius.

ability.name: Divine Blast
ability.description: Deals 2400 damage to all enemies in front of you, up to 65 feet away.

coreAbilities.name: Burn Armor
coreAbilities.description: A surprise attack that burns all targets 40 feet in front of you, causing them to take 187 Spirit damage  and reducing their armor by 660 for the next 15 seconds. Your abilities will cost 50% fewer Action Points for 10 seconds. Builds 2 Accusations.

coreAbilities.name: Razor Strike
coreAbilities.description: A quick precision strike that deals 180 damage to up to 3 enemies in front of you within 15 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Trial By Pain
coreAbilities.note:
Execution - Requires Accusations
Requires Pistol
Costs 20% fewer action points per Accusation spent
coreAbilities.description:
A barrage of withering fire that damages your target for up to 3 seconds, as long as you maintain your concentration.
   1 Accusation:  129 damage per shot
   2 Accusations:  167 damage per shot.
   3 Accusations:  206 damage per shot
   4 Accusations:  242 damage per shot
   5 Accusations:  280 damage per shot

coreAbilities.name: Seeker's Blade
coreAbilities.description: A melee attack that can not be defended against, and deals 314 damage.  If the target is Ailing, then they will also become Cursed for 15 seconds, reducing their chances to block, parry, dodge, and disrupt attacks by 5%.

coreAbilities.name: Blessed Bullets of Cleansing
coreAbilities.description:
You load your pistol with bullets designed to fragment on impact. Whenever you hit an enemy with your Executions, you deal an additional 375 Spirit damage to the target.  The victim will lose 20 Action Points, and you will gain 20 Action Points.

This ability may be used while Incognito without breaking the effect.

paths.name: Path of Inquisition
paths.description: A mastery path focused on longer-duration weakening effects

ability.name: Blessed Ammunition
ability.description: Incendiary Shot now applies your Blessed Bullets.

ability.name: Shroud of Magnus
ability.description:
Rumored to be the death shroud of Magnus the Pious, this holy relic increases your chance to Disrupt enemy magic by 100% and reduces all magical damage taken by 100% for 7 seconds.
You may only use a single relic at a time.

ability.name: Prolonged Confession
ability.description: All attacks that build Accusations have a 50% chance to build an additional Accusation.

ability.name: Punish The False
ability.description: A precision blow that deals 277 damage, and causes a lingering wound which reduces the effectiveness of incoming healing by 50% for 10 seconds.

ability.name: Protection from Heresy
ability.description: While Incognito, your movement speed is increased by 20% and you regain 160 health every 3 seconds.

ability.name: Exit Wound
ability.note:
Execution - Requires Accusations
Requires Pistol
Costs 20% fewer action points per Accusation spent
ability.description:
You fire a hollow point shell, dealing damage immediately and reducing the target's Toughness, Strength, and Weapon Skill for 10 seconds.
   1 Accusation:  314 damage; stats reduced by 100.
    2 Accusations:  400 damage; stats reduced by 138.
    3 Accusations:  490 damage; stats reduced by 175.
    4 Accusations:  577 damage; stats reduced by 213.
    5 Accusations:  661 damage; stats reduced by 250.

ability.name: Excommunicate
ability.description: For the next 10 seconds, heals will have no effects on your target.  The target and all other enemies within 20 feet of them will suffer 1800 damage over 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Fervor
coreAbilities.description: A precise incision that deals 138 damage, and an additional 297 Spirit damage over 9 seconds.  This effect can be stacked up to 3 times.

coreAbilities.name: Burn, Heretic!
coreAbilities.note:
Execution - Requires Accusations
Requires Pistol
Costs 20% fewer action points per Accusation spent
coreAbilities.description:
Unleash a purifying blaze from your torch, searing all targets within 25 feet with holy fire for 10 seconds.
   1 Accusation:  835 Spirit damage
   2 Accusations:  1080 Spirit damage
   3 Accusations:  1330 Spirit damage
   4 Accusations:  1585 Spirit damage
   5 Accusations:  1830 Spirit damage

coreAbilities.name: Blessed Bullets of Confession
coreAbilities.description:
You load your pistol with bullets doused in holy water. Whenever you hit an enemy with your Executions, you deal an additional 375 Spirit damage.  Any healing abilities that the victim uses over the next 5 seconds will become 50% as effective.

This ability may be used while Incognito without breaking the effect.

coreAbilities.name: Incendiary Shot
coreAbilities.description: You purge your enemy with an incendiary shot that deals 138 Spirit damage to your target and 375 over 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Sudden Accusation
coreAbilities.description: You leap from the shadows and accuse your target of heresy. Your target will take 112 Spirit damage every time they move for 15 seconds. Your abilities will cost 50% fewer Action Points for 10 seconds. Builds 2 Accusations.

paths.name: Path of Judgment
paths.description: A mastery path focused on surprise attacks and positional combat

ability.name: Vitriolic Judgement
ability.description: Any time you strike an enemy in the back, there is a 25% chance that they will lose 225 points of Morale.

ability.name: Sanctified Oil
ability.description:
You light and drop a flask of sanctified oil at your feet. You will become invisible to enemies for 3 seconds.
You may only use a single relic at a time.

ability.name: Unyielding Conviction
ability.description: Silence The Heretic no longer requires you to be behind the target to deal damage and it builds an additional Accusation.

ability.name: Pistol Whip
ability.note:
Requires Pistol
Builds 1 Accusation
Target must be facing away from you
ability.description: A quick backhand blow with the butt of your pistol that deals 389 damage and knocks your target down for 3 seconds.

ability.name: Atonement
ability.description: Increases Absolution's & Burn Away Lies' chance to critically hit by 25%.

ability.name: Burn Away Lies
ability.note:
Execution - Requires Accusations
Target must be facing away from you
Costs 20% fewer action points per Accusation spent
ability.description:
Harness the purifying flames of your torch to unleash judgment upon your target. The fire scorches them over 9 seconds before erupting in a final, wrathful blaze that sears their very soul for additional damage.
   1 Accusation:  957 damage over time; 482 ending damage.
   2 Accusations:  1236 damage over time; 630 ending damage.
   3 Accusations:  1518 damage over time; 768 ending damage.
   4 Accusations:  1800 damage over time; 910 ending damage.
   5 Accusations:  2082 damage over time; 1055 ending damage.

ability.name: Expurgation
ability.description: Deals 2400 damage over 10 seconds to all enemies within 25 feet and snares them, reducing their run speed by 30%.

coreAbilities.name: Torment
coreAbilities.description: A destructive thrust that deals 239 damage to your enemy. If you are behind your target, this attack will ignore armor.

coreAbilities.name: Absolution
coreAbilities.note:
Execution - Requires Accusations
Requires Pistol
Costs 20% fewer action points per Accusation spent
coreAbilities.description:
A precision shot to the enemy's vital organs which deals damage based on combo points.
   1 Accusation:  227 damage. 
   2 Accusations:  314 damage.
   3 Accusations:  400 damage.
   4 Accusations:  489 damage.
   5 Accusations:  576 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Blessed Bullets of Purity
coreAbilities.description:
You load your pistol with bullets of purest silver. Whenever you hit an enemy with your Executions, you deal an additional 375 Spirit damage.  The victim's Initiative will be reduced by 100 for 10 seconds, and your Initiative will be increased by 100.

This ability may be used while Incognito without breaking the effect.

coreAbilities.name: Silence The Heretic
coreAbilities.description: A punishing blow that silences your target, making them unable to use magic for 4 seconds.  If you are behind your target, then you will also deal 277 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Fanatical Zeal
coreAbilities.description: You leap from the shadows, fueled with righteous anger. Your target will take 262 Spirit damage every time they use a magical ability for the next 15 seconds. Their chance to be critically hit is increased by 10% when they are hit from the rear. Your abilities will cost 50% fewer Action Points for 10 seconds. Builds 2 Accusations.

coreAbilities.name: Pick Lock
coreAbilities.description: You bolster yourself for 10 seconds, allowing you to bypass the defenses of an enemy keep's postern door, porting you inside.

coreAbilities.name: Booby Trap
coreAbilities.description: You booby trap a siege ram, causing the ram to deal 98% of the original damage for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Faultfinder
coreAbilities.description: Increases friendly ram damage by 2% for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Snap Shot
coreAbilities.description:
A quick pistol shot that deals 80 damage, and can be used on the run.
Your attack will snare the enemy if used behind your target, reducing their run speed by 40% for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Incognito
coreAbilities.description: You begin quietly hunting for heretics, making it less likely that hostile monsters will notice you but draining away 5 action points each second.  This effect will end if you use any abilities, run out of action points.

coreAbilities.name: Get Thee Behind Me!
coreAbilities.description:
Detaunts all enemies within 25 feet, making them hate you less and causing them to deal only 50% damage to you for 15 seconds. You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken.
If you hit anyone that you have Detaunted, the effect will end.

coreAbilities.name: Feinted Positioning
coreAbilities.description: Your positional attacks can be used without the positional requirement for 10 seconds. Does not affect morale abilities.

coreAbilities.name: Sever Nerve
coreAbilities.description: A directed strike that inflicts 1200 damage to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Emperor's Ward
coreAbilities.description:
Any time you are attacked, there is a 25% chance that you will become protected by a magical barrier for up to 10 seconds, which will absorb up to 375 damage.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Sigil of Sigmar
coreAbilities.description: An artifact of the Temple of Sigmar which removes all roots and snares from you.  For the next 10 seconds, roots and snares will have no effect on you.

coreAbilities.name: Force of Will
coreAbilities.description: You stare down your opponent, draining 200 of their Action Points into yourself, and reducing their Strength by 160 for 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Jagged Edge
coreAbilities.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy they will begin to bleed, suffering additional 498 Corporeal damage over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Confess!
coreAbilities.description: A savage counterattack that deals 314 damage and disarms your target for 4 seconds, making them unable to use their weapons.

coreAbilities.name: Inquisitor's Fury
coreAbilities.description: Each time you critically hit an enemy, your autoattack speed will be increased by 50% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Brute Force
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Strength by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Confusing Movements
coreAbilities.description: Concentrating on your perceived movements, you will be able to Dodge and Parry all attacks against you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Sweeping Razor
coreAbilities.description: Razor Strike will now deal damage to all enemies in front of you within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Unwavering Faith
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Spirit resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Relentless Assault
coreAbilities.description: A prolonged fervor that grants 10 Action Points a second to everyone in your group within 100 feet of you for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flowing Accusations
coreAbilities.description: All of your Executions gain a 50% chance to restore 2 Accusations.

coreAbilities.name: Sever Blessing
coreAbilities.note:
Target must have a Blessing
Builds 1 Accusation
coreAbilities.description: You sever one Blessing from your enemy and do 127 damage

coreAbilities.name: Fanatical Cleansing
coreAbilities.description: Your critical hits will inflict 50% more damage.

coreAbilities.name: Sigmar's Favor
coreAbilities.description: Any time that you are healed by a direct heal, there is a 25% chance that you will regain an additional 135 hit points as well.

coreAbilities.name: Overpowering Blow
coreAbilities.description: You strike your opponent with surprising force, dealing 1200 damage and knocking them down for 4 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flanking
coreAbilities.description:
All of your attacks deal 15% more damage when you strike an enemy from the sides or rear.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Close Combat
coreAbilities.description: Any time you strike an enemy in melee with a direct attack, you will receive 25% less damage from ranged and magical attacks for 2 seconds. This effect will not guard or detaunt abilities.

coreAbilities.name: Righteous Steel
coreAbilities.description: Increases your chance to parry attacks by 10%.

coreAbilities.name: Exoneration
coreAbilities.description: Sigmar's blessing removes all Hexes, Curses, and Ailments from you. You will regain 50 AP and 300 health for each effect removed.

coreAbilities.name: Riposte
coreAbilities.description: Each time you parry an enemy's attack, you will strike them back for 239 damage which they can not prevent.

coreAbilities.name: Penetrating Barbs
coreAbilities.description: Increases the durations of Fanatical Zeal, Burn Armor, and Sudden Accusation by an additional 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Reversal of Fortune
coreAbilities.description: You turn your enemy's luck against them, dealing 1200 damage to all targets in line in front of you, up to 65 feet away from you.

coreAbilities.name: Full Confession
coreAbilities.description: Confess! no longer costs action points, and it will nearly always critically hit.

coreAbilities.name: Declare Anathema
coreAbilities.note:
You cannot perform this action while rooted
You cannot perform this action while airborne
coreAbilities.description: You leap backwards from your target, causing your target to be Staggered for up to 6 seconds, preventing all actions unless they're damaged.

coreAbilities.name: Vindication
coreAbilities.description:
Each time you disrupt an enemy's spell, you will deal 25% more damage for 10 seconds.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Witchfinder's Protection
coreAbilities.description: Everyone in your group within 100 feet of you has a 25% increased chance to parry, dodge, or disrupt attacks for 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Encourage Confession
coreAbilities.description: Your Blessed Bullets will now also increase the target's chance to be critically hit by 5% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Blood, Faith, And Fire
coreAbilities.description: Any time you land a killing blow on your enemy, all of your groupmates within 100 feet will regain 125 Action Points and your next attack will deal 573 Spirit damage  over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Purgatory
coreAbilities.description: You drive your stake through the heretic's heart, invoking Sigmar's name to repel the abomination. They cannot be resurrected for the next 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Frenzied Slaughter
coreAbilities.description: All of your abilities will cost 25% fewer action points, cool down 50% faster, and deal 20% more damage for 7 seconds.
